name: assertLanguage
description: Examines the user-visible strings on screen and reports, for each candidate, whether it is genuinely written in the wrong language. Include a string you considered and judged acceptable with isViolation false rather than omitting it.

text.description: The offending string, copied exactly as it appears on screen

detectedLanguage.description: The language the string appears to be written in

isViolation.description: True only if this string is genuinely a translation gap. False for anything you judge acceptable -- a proper noun or brand, a word spelled identically in the expected language, or text that is not ours to translate. Set it honestly: entries with false are discarded, so there is no need to omit them.

reasoning.description: Why this string is, or is not, a translation gap -- state the verdict's justification either way.
